notes.title: Collect More Steam Goodies!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, gamers!

We're excited to announce that you can now earn even more awesome community items on Steam! Collect new trading cards, decorate your profile with beautiful backgrounds, use fresh emoticons, and add stylish frames to your avatars.

Play and earn these unique rewards. Thank you for staying with us!

Best regards,
Octo Games Team[/h3]
